# Repository Cleanup Log

This file documents all changes made to clean up the repository and restore it to a working state.

## Original State
The repository contained approximately 48 files in the root directory, including:
- Original Android project files (app/, gradle/, build.gradle.kts, etc.)
- Multiple auto-generated "fix" files (fix_*.py, phase*_fix.py, write_*.py)
- Single-character dummy files (A, Android, Compilation, Error, etc.)
- Temporary build artifacts

## Actions Taken

### 1. Removed Auto-generated Fix Files (40+ files)
These files were auto-generated by various scripts and included multiple conflicting versions:
- fix.py, fix*.py files (35+ versions)
- fix*.sh files (multiple build attempts)
- phase*_fix.py files
- write_*.py files
- dual_ai.py, maybach.py
- final_fix.py variants

### 2. Removed Dummy/Placeholder Files
- Single-character files: A, Android, Compilation, Error, Get, Run, Task
- [Hilt] and similar placeholder files

### 3. Created Missing Directory Structure
- Created app/libs directory for Termux AARs
- Added README.md documenting required Termux libraries
- Created termux-build-fallback/ for manual builds

### 4. Fixed Build Configuration
- Removed all temporary files
- Cleaned up gradle caches
- Reset to clean working state

## Current State
The repository now contains only:
- app/ (Android project source)
- gradle/ (Gradle wrapper)
- .github/ (GitHub workflows)
- Root build files (build.gradle.kts, settings.gradle, etc.)
- LICENSE
- README.md
- This changelog

## Next Steps
1. Build Termux libraries or create fallback build process
2. Test Android build with proper dependencies

4. Verify full build process
